CompanyProfile.title: Company Profile
CompanyProfile.description: Represents a tax-registered company profile in Venezuela with its annual 24-quincena Forma 30 IVA data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the company profile

rif.description: Tax Identification Number (RIF - Registro de Información Fiscal)

periodData.description: Dictionary of quincena tax period records indexed by period key (e.g. 2025-01-1)

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when company was last updated

/companies/{companyId}.description: Collection storing all Venezuelan company tax profiles and their annual 24-quincena IVA summaries.
